slides.headline: Know What To Order
slides.description: Title slide: kicker label, headline text, and a thin accent line on a dark gradient background. No bullet list, diagram, or chart is shown.
bullets: Decisions become effortless for unfamiliar diners
Confidence starts before the first bite
slides.narration: MenuMatch turns menu uncertainty into confident choices, especially for tourists and first-time guests.

slides.headline: From Menu Photo To Match
slides.description: Editorial slide: kicker label, headline, and a bordered box containing the slide's bullet points as the on-screen text.
bullets: OCR reads dishes, prices, categories, and images
GPS confirms the exact restaurant branch
slides.narration: One menu photo launches an intelligent process that identifies the restaurant and understands every available dish.

slides.headline: Reviews Become Dish Intelligence
slides.description: Illustrated pipeline diagram: kicker, headline, and numbered circular stages connected by downward arrows, each labeled with a step of the process.
bullets: Permitted review sources reveal dish-level opinions
AI connects translations, misspellings, and descriptions
Sentiment explains what diners loved or disliked
slides.narration: MenuMatch goes beyond restaurant ratings, connecting real review language to specific dishes and meaningful dining experiences.

slides.headline: Recommendations With Receipts
slides.description: Scorecard slide: kicker, headline, and a bordered box listing label/value stat rows summarizing the project's real scope.
bullets: Top picks cover five dining categories
Rankings combine sentiment, frequency, recency, and photos
Every recommendation includes clear review evidence
slides.narration: Guests receive an appetiser, main, signature dish, dessert, and drink, each supported by transparent evidence.

slides.headline: Trust That Learns Over Time
slides.description: Closing slide: kicker label and headline on a dark gradient background, matching the opening slide's style. No bullet list, diagram, or chart is shown.
bullets: Human prompts resolve ambiguous restaurants or dishes
slides.narration: Built-in confidence checks and human guidance protect trust, while feedback makes every future recommendation more personal.
